summary.headline: Unimech H1 FY27 revenue rose 85% YoY to INR231 crore at 38% EBITDA margin; order book INR855 crore, up over 700% YoY.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 revenue was about INR123 crore, up 98% YoY and 14% QoQ, with Q2 PAT of about INR32 crore (24% margin). H1 PAT reached INR60 crore, up 71% YoY, and management said H1 already equals about 96% of FY26 revenue and about 94% of FY26 PAT. Management guided H2 revenue above H1 at similar margins, driven by semiconductor, nuclear and Hobel. The company said the consolidated order book is INR855 crore, of which about INR589 crore is tied to LTAs and award letters, and it flagged working capital rising toward 150-160 days by end-FY27 and a possible equity raise in early CY27.

segments.name: Aero tooling
segments.commentary: Contributed about 67% of H1 FY27 revenue; anchor business on short-cycle PO-to-PO orders, with long-term supply agreements being negotiated for high-demand tools such as engine stands.

segments.name: Precision components and assemblies (PCA)
segments.commentary: Contributed about 33% of H1 revenue, of which Hobel accounted for 30% of total H1 consolidated revenue. Management said semiconductor was still small in H1 with a step-up expected in H2.

segments.name: Hobel Bellows
segments.commentary: Acquired entity; integration complete, with demand from key customers strong and additional capacity requested. AS9100 certification for the Vizag facility targeted by Feb 2027.

segments.name: Dheya Engineering (associate)
segments.commentary: Unimech holds about 27% equity and exclusive manufacturing rights for micro gas turbines; Avaana Capital invested at about INR200 crore valuation on 26 Sep 2026. 40 kg thrust engine in serial production initiation.

guidance_outlook: H2 FY27 revenue expected to exceed H1 at similar margins, driven by semiconductor capital goods OEM deliveries, nuclear orders and steady run-rate in other businesses.
H1 EBITDA margin (~38%) considered sustainable for FY27; H2 margins expected to be maintained.
Aspiration of INR1,000 crore revenue, a broad indication rather than formal guidance; about 20% of that vision expected from Hobel; internal accruals sufficient for it.
Gross block expected to reach roughly INR500 crore by end FY27 including JV; asset turns of 2-2.5x cited.
Working capital days expected to move to 150-160 days by end FY27.
Over 590 qualified parts targeted by end FY27 (250+ qualified plus 340+ in throughput); 320+ parts targeted for qualification in FY27.
Saudi JV commercial manufacturing readiness targeted March or April 2027; Dheya's 20/40/50/100 kg engine variants targeted by March 2027.
Equity fundraise considered in early calendar 2027, also to help meet minimum public shareholding; needed for larger expansion, not for the INR1,000 crore vision.
capex_capacity: Facilities at about 65% utilisation, including 15-20% of capacity reserved for new production introduction, prove-outs and qualification.

Automated special process cells (anodizing, electroless nickel, passivation, zinc/cadmium plating, heat treatment, NDT) at existing facility: trials in Oct-Nov 2026, commissioning by 26 Dec 2026, Nadcap targeted 27 Mar 2027.
Saudi JV capex roughly INR200-250 crore; construction on schedule with Kanoo Group. Initial equity of about USD4 million (call transcript states USD4 billion and USD4 million in different places).
Management believes existing capacity suffices for about the next 2 years, but expansion decisions for the 3-5 year opportunity are under internal assessment; capacity build takes 18-24 months.
demand_pricing: Semiconductor: one established customer and two in pipeline; 60 FAIs qualified; another 20 parts/assemblies targeted by end of calendar 2026; discussions with a Dutch semiconductor OEM for tooling.

Aerospace: three established customers and several in pipeline. Contracts include FACC (USD7.5 million, five-year aerostructure LTA, may double), a French Tier 1 door-components programme (about USD43 million over 10 years), and Honeywell (10-year LTA for engine and control-system components, extendable).
Nuclear: four new reactors in bidding stage through Tier 1 bidders, with opportunity possibly before calendar year-end; about 13-15 sub-assemblies qualified.
Management declined to disclose margins by vertical or customer, citing internal policy; directionally said to look at the overall picture rather than product-level margins.
Management said competition is not the main concern in semiconductors; scale is the constraint.

qa_highlights.question: What share of H1 revenue came from semiconductor, and what is expected in H2? Status of the semiconductor LTA?
qa_highlights.answer: Semiconductor is small in H1, within a PCA contribution of about 33% of revenue. Management expects a step-up in H2 and further qualifications leading to an LTA; it did not quantify.

qa_highlights.question: What do the INR589 crore of LTA and award letters within the order book comprise, and when does execution start?
qa_highlights.answer: The INR589 crore is linked to FACC, Honeywell and a French Tier 1, with visibility spanning 5-10 years. Execution depends on continued qualification, supported by firm POs and exhibit forecasts.

qa_highlights.question: What peak revenue can existing infrastructure support without new capex?
qa_highlights.answer: Management gave no forward guidance on this. It cited a INR1,000 crore revenue aspiration, sufficient capacity for about 2 years, and asset turns of about 2-2.5x on gross block.

qa_highlights.question: Will FY28 and FY29 margins be based on the H1 level?
qa_highlights.answer: The company said it is too early to set FY28-29 margins and it will guide one year at a time. H2 FY27 margins are expected to match H1.

qa_highlights.question: What is the Dheya UAV engine revenue timeline?
qa_highlights.answer: Customers are testing the engine on their platforms, and revenue would follow that testing. Management implied FY28 or FY29 at the earliest, with serial production in 2027-28.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the proposed fundraise is for the INR1,000 crore vision versus new capacity?
qa_highlights.answer: Internal accruals are enough for the INR1,000 crore vision. The raise is for larger expansion and possibly inorganic growth, because RFQs need visible capacity.

qa_highlights.question: How do margins change as the mix shifts toward precision components?
qa_highlights.answer: Mix is expected to move toward roughly 50:50 tooling and PCA at the INR1,000 crore scale. PCA carries slightly lower margins, so compression is expected, with R&D adding 1-2% margin pressure, but management does not expect a large decline.

risks_watch: Revenue visibility depends on converting qualification and first-article-inspection pipelines (250+ qualified, 340+ in throughput) into serial production; management said harvesting is mainly a FY28 event.
Working capital is set to rise from about 110 days to 150-160 days, which could pressure cash flow.
Capacity constraint risk: utilisation is about 65%, and new capex timing is still under review, with a possible equity raise in early CY27.
Dheya engine certification milestones (CDR before Dec 2026, final certification by Feb 2027) and Saudi JV commercial readiness (Mar/Apr 2027) are dated items to track.

Inconsistent figures in the transcript: the Saudi equity is stated as both USD4 billion and USD4 million; the Honeywell contract tenure is stated as 10 years extendable by 2 years and also as 12 years; the order book growth is stated as 700%+ and 715%. Verify against filings.
summary.management_tone: Confident and forward-looking on growth, order book and qualification pipeline, but evasive on specifics: product and customer details for Honeywell and margins by vertical were withheld citing NDA and internal policy, and FY28-29 margins and peak capacity were not quantified.
key_quotes: As of September 30th, our consolidated order book stands at INR855 crore representing an increase over of over 700% on a year-on-year basis.
We expect working capital days to gradually move towards the 150 to 160-day range by end of FY27.
Competition is not a concern, scale is and we are basically building scale to address the customer's needs.
We will not be a shop where we will just keep doing FAIs for you with no horizon for serial production.

financial_highlights.change: expected to move to 150-160 days by end FY27

adds.what: Automated special process cells (anodizing, electroless nickel, passivation, zinc/cadmium plating, heat treatment, NDT) at existing facility
Saudi JV manufacturing facility (capex roughly INR200-250 crore, with Kanoo Group)

growth.why: Management guides H2 FY27 revenue above H1 (H1 INR231 crore) at similar margins, backed by an INR855 crore order book (about INR589 crore under LTAs/award letters) and 65% utilisation, though no formal full-year revenue number is given and the INR1,000 crore vision is only an aspiration.
